name: Clapton Beauty Parlour
descriptor: Hair & beauty · 21 Lower Clapton Road, E5

logo.title: The Sunrise Fan.
logo.lead: An Art Deco sunburst, the defining motif of 1930, the year the Parlour opened. It also reads as a salon hand mirror or an open fan. Gold rays sit on lacquer black with a blush-pink sun. The wordmark is set in Bodoni Moda, the high-contrast type of a 1930s fashion plate.

story.title: A 1930 salon with a famous guest.
story.lead: Jean and Emanuel Manning opened the Clapton Beauty Parlour in 1930. In the 1940s a teenage Vidal Sassoon worked from it while his own salon was repaired after bomb damage, and it was later the "in shop" for the Beverley Sisters. The brand leans into that glamour, with Art Deco elegance, but stays warm and neighbourly. It's still a local salon on Lower Clapton Road.
story.positioning: The Hackney salon with real history. Old-school glamour, with the care of a family business.

colour.title: Lacquer, blush and gilt.
colour.lead: Black lacquer and gold come from 1930s salon mirrors and deco shopfronts. Blush pink is the powder-room warmth, and mint is a quiet deco accent for small details. Use gold for lines and ornament, never for body text.

type.title: Fashion-plate serif, deco sans.
type.lead: Bodoni Moda has the high contrast of 1930s beauty adverts, and Jost is a geometric sans in the spirit of Futura (1927). Set labels in wide-tracked caps for the deco signage feel. Both are free on Google Fonts.

samples.label: Body 400
samples.text: Cuts, colour, extensions and beauty treatments on Lower Clapton Road.

voice.title: Glamorous, never snooty.
voice.lead: A touch of old-Hollywood charm in headlines, and friendly, plain English everywhere else. Tell the history with pride, but never make a regular feel they're not fancy enough.
pairs: "Exclusive luxury hair experiences for the discerning client."

imagery.title: Mirrors, hands and archive.
imagery.lead: Shoot finished looks in the salon mirrors with warm tungsten light, close-ups of hands at work, and the family's archive photos (scanned, never filtered). Avoid generic stock models and pink-neon Instagram clichés.
